name: Cloud Destination Accounts - Unauthorized [ends with]
description: Intent: Explicitly unauthorized cloud destination accounts — populate only with tenant-suffix patterns of accounts that must never be used (e.g., a known-bad partner spinoff, a deprecated tenant). Currently unconsumed — staged for future per-account block granularity beyond the Authorized/negated baseline; expected consumer surface is M2010 / W2010 / B2000. Exclusions: do not populate unless you have specific named account-level prohibitions; prefer leaving the Authorized list authoritative and letting non-listed accounts fall into Unauthorized.
